changes: Your daily summary now appears at the top of Chat — the day's headline, stats, highlights, and action items, with a one-tap follow-up question
The first app you open after setup now gets a notch card that opens Ask Omi with a question about your screen already typed

When Omi can't see your screen during a voice question, it now explains why — Screen Recording isn't granted, was granted after Omi launched and needs a reopen, or the screen just wasn't available — instead of flatly saying it couldn't verify the current screen.
